main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next 5-bar return minus coin drift on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next 5-bar return minus coin drift on grid bars with forecast > 0, above 0

decided_by: Confirm: the slope is positive with t >= 2 and the mean excess 5-bar return on forecast > 0 grid bars is above 0.
reading: The coin's normal drift is its mean next 5-bar return over all its grid bars (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window) pooled across windows, the slope is an OLS with intercept over all grid bars with a forecast, and the plan's 'at least 100 grid bars with forecast > 0' minimum is applied as a minimum count giving 'not observable'.
